== Summary ==
Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 23: the slip of [[Broken Concentration (V)#Source formats|Broken Concentration (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014), cropped at 300 dpi. It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on table. Cancels game text of [Reflections 3] Naboo sites. Training destiny draws are -X, where X = apprentice's ability - Jedi Test number. Once per game, may place this Effect out of play to reduce your battle damage by 4. Immune to NOOOOOOOOOOOO! (V){{!}}NOOOOOOOOOOOO!. (Immune to Alter.)”).<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Not an official image file.''' Crop made 11 November 2026 for batch C2/C3 (swccg-guild/work#236). Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
